"""CSV payload builder for the marketing_sync integration."""

from __future__ import annotations


def _csv_field(value: str) -> str:
    """Return one field encoded using RFC-4180-style quoting."""
    if any(character in value for character in (",", '"', "\r", "\n")):
        return '"' + value.replace('"', '""') + '"'
    return value


def build_payload(contacts: list[dict]) -> str:
    """Build a CSV payload containing all includable contacts."""
    header = "CONT_ID,EMAIL_TX,FRST_NM,LAST_NM,PREF_CH"
    rows = [header]

    for contact in contacts:
        if contact.get("DEL_FLG", "") == "Y":
            continue
        if contact.get("OPTOUT_FLG", "") == "Y":
            continue

        preference = contact.get("PREF_CH", "")
        if preference == "":
            preference = "E"

        fields = (
            contact.get("CONT_ID", ""),
            contact.get("EMAIL_TX", ""),
            contact.get("FRST_NM", ""),
            contact.get("LAST_NM", ""),
            preference,
        )
        rows.append(",".join(_csv_field(field) for field in fields))

    return "\n".join(rows) + "\n"
